question: A convex lens forms a sharp image of a distant object on a screen placed at 20 cm from the lens. The power of the lens is nearly equal to:
solution:
The correct answer is 5D__**.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The relationship between the focal length (f) of a lens and its power (P) is given by:
 
 
• P=1/f [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] " id="MathJax-Element-3-Frame" role="presentation" style="text-align: center; position: relative;" tabindex="0">
 
 
 
• The image is formed at a distance of **20 cm** from the lens.
 
• Since the image of a distant object is formed on the screen, this distance represents the focal length of the lens.
 
• Thus, f==20cm=0.2m.f=20 cm=0.2 m f = 20 \, \text{cm} = 0.2 \, \text{m}" id="MathJax-Element-4-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">f=20 cm=0.2 
 
• First, we have to convert the focal length into meters:
 
 
• f=20cm=0.2m
 
 
 
• Now, substituting into the power formula:
 
 
• P=1/0.2=5D
 
 
 
• so, The power of the convex lens that forms a sharp image of a distant object on a screen placed 20 cm from the lens is approximately **5 Diopters (D)**.
